summary: Enterprise AI model API aggregators are managed cloud platforms that let corporations access multiple foundation models (GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini, Mistral, and more) through a unified, secure API while keeping data inside their own cloud environment and compliance boundary. As of 2026, the market is dominated by the three hyperscalers (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI/Foundry, Google Vertex AI), with data-platform-native options (Snowflake Cortex, Databricks) and governance-focused suites (IBM watsonx) gaining ground; there is no single winner, only a best fit based on existing cloud contracts, model preferences, and compliance needs.
why_enterprises_use_aggregators: Data residency and privacy: inference runs inside the enterprise's own cloud tenant/VPC so prompts and outputs never leave their controlled environment or get used for model training.
Compliance and governance: built-in support for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, FedRAMP and centralized audit logging that direct vendor APIs often lack out of the box.
Single billing and procurement: consolidated invoicing through existing cloud spend commitments (EDPs, MACC, committed-use discounts) avoids onboarding each model vendor separately.
Model optionality and avoiding lock-in: one API surface across many foundation models lets teams switch or A/B models without rewriting integrations or renegotiating contracts.

Enterprise integration and security: native identity (IAM/Entra), private networking, VPC endpoints, encryption with customer-managed keys, and unified monitoring tie AI into existing cloud security posture.

platforms.name: Azure OpenAI Service / Azure AI Foundry
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per 1K/1M tokens (input/output priced separately) plus Provisioned Throughput Units (PTUs) for reserved capacity; billed through Azure with MACC commitment eligibility.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises standardized on Microsoft/Azure that want first-party access to the latest OpenAI frontier models with deep Office 365 and Entra integration.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.pricing: On-demand per-token pricing per model, plus Provisioned Throughput (model units) for reserved capacity and Batch mode discounts; billed through AWS with EDP commitment eligibility.
platforms.best_for: AWS-centric enterprises wanting the widest multi-vendor model choice (especially Claude) with strong serverless tooling, agents, and RAG.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI Model Garden
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per-token/character or per-image; capacity reserved via Generative AI Scale Units (GSUs) — e.g., 25 GSUs of Gemini 2.5 Flash yields roughly 67,250 tokens/sec sustained; committed-use discounts available.
platforms.best_for: Data/ML-heavy enterprises on Google Cloud wanting native Gemini plus strong MLOps, multimodal, and grounding/search capabilities.

platforms.name: Snowflake Cortex AI
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based billed in Snowflake credits per token/function call; folds into existing Snowflake capacity contract with no separate model vendor invoices.
key_features: models run next to governed data in Snowflake
Cortex Analyst / Search for RAG over structured + unstructured data
platforms.best_for: Organizations with their data warehouse in Snowflake that want LLM inference directly on governed data without building a separate AI pipeline.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx.ai
available_models: selected third-party and open-source models (Hugging Face)
platforms.pricing: Resource-unit (RU) consumption pricing plus subscription tiers; deployable on IBM Cloud, on-premises, or other clouds (hybrid).
key_features: watsonx.governance for audit, bias, and risk management
watsonx Orchestrate for cross-platform agent management
platforms.best_for: Regulated enterprises (finance, government, healthcare) needing strong AI governance, hybrid/on-prem deployment, and IP-indemnified models.

platforms.name: Databricks Mosaic AI (Foundation Model APIs)
available_models: Google / OpenAI via external model gateway
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based (DBUs) for pay-per-token and provisioned throughput; runs within the customer's cloud account (AWS/Azure/GCP).
key_features: AI Gateway for unified/external model routing
models run next to lakehouse data
platforms.best_for: Lakehouse/data-engineering-centric enterprises that want to build, fine-tune, and serve models on governed data with full MLOps.

platforms.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per-character/token plus dedicated AI clusters for reserved capacity; included in OCI commitments (Oracle Universal Credits).
key_features: dedicated AI clusters for isolated capacity
platforms.best_for: Oracle-centric and sovereign/regulated enterprises wanting generative AI tightly integrated with Oracle Database and Fusion applications.

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
platforms.pricing: Serverless pay-per-use based on 'Neurons' (compute units) / tokens with a free tier; billed through Cloudflare, no GPU provisioning required.
key_features: AI Gateway for caching, rate limiting and analytics
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises wanting low-latency, globally distributed, serverless inference on open models at the network edge.
